These notes introduce differential calculus: limits, continuity, derivatives, and their applications. They grow alongside the lectures, with explanations, graphs, and worked examples organized by topic.

[Start reading](lectures/01-introduction.qmd){.start-link}

## Find a topic

[**Functions and graphs**](lectures/00-functions.qmd)  
Review functions, domains, trigonometry, and logarithms.

[**Limits**](lectures/02-limits.qmd) · [Infinite limits](lectures/03-infinite-limits.qmd)  
Understand approaching values through graphs, tables, and one-sided limits.

[**Limit laws**](lectures/04-limit-laws.qmd) · [Squeeze theorem](lectures/05-squeeze-theorem.qmd)  
Compute limits with algebra, bounds, and trigonometric identities.

[**Continuity**](lectures/06-continuity.qmd) · [Intermediate Value Theorem](lectures/07-intermediate-value.qmd)  
Connect limits to function values and prove that solutions exist.
